# CANDIDATE: SHOTGUN_SCALPER_STAGE3_TOP_KEEPER

**Filed:** 2026-07-08
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** exit_change

## Hypothesis

We are trying to capture edge by using a very tight stop (35%) and a very high TP1 (150%) to let winners run and cut losses quickly, combined with a short time stop (15 min) to avoid overnight risk, and trading OTM-2 strikes to reduce premium and increase gamma exposure. The chandelier profit-lock arms at 50% gain to secure profits before trailing, and the low volume threshold (1.0) ensures entries only occur on at least average volume to avoid illiquid conditions. This combination aims to avoid large losses while allowing winners to extend to high multiples.

## Mechanism

Entry: triggers when the volume ratio (current volume / 20-bar average volume) >= 1.0 (at least average volume) and the underlying shotgun_scalper entry conditions are met (assumed baseline trigger logic unchanged).

Exit:
  - TP1: at 150% of entry premium (sell 2/3 of position)
  - Stop: at 35% loss of entry premium (catastrophe cap; chart-stop remains primary invalidation per doctrine)
  - Time stop: 15 minutes
  - Chandelier profit-lock: arms at 50% gain, then trails at 15% off high-water mark (fixed trail per doctrine)
  - Contract selection: OTM-2 strike (strike_offset=2)
